patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. Download the patch file from the link below Move the downloaded 'ContentPatch.rpa' file into the 'game' folder mentioned above It's working if: In the options menu there is a new "Patch" toggle available.
